A_standard.description: Train-aligned baseline template (same as FT training format)

B_expert.description: Expert persona via system message — emphasizes precision and offset correctness
B_expert.system: You are an expert named entity recognition system. You identify every named entity in the input text with high precision. Output character-level offsets using Python slice convention: text[start:end] == entity_text.

C_descriptive.description: Rich type descriptions — provides definitions for each entity type
C_descriptive.user_template:
Extract named entities from the following text. Classify each entity using the type definitions below.

Entity type definitions:
- person: Person names (politicians, athletes, authors, scientists)
- organization: Organizations, companies, teams, institutions, agencies
- location: Geographic locations, countries, cities, regions
- building: Buildings, facilities, landmarks, airports, stadiums
- art: Artworks, songs, films, books, creative works, albums
- product: Commercial products, software, vehicles, technologies
- event: Events, competitions, wars, festivals, ceremonies
- other: Other named entities not fitting the above categories

Text: {text}

Output format:
{"entities": [{"text": "exact span from text", "type": "TYPE", "start": <char_offset>, "end": <char_offset>}], "relations": [], "events": []}

D_recall.description: Recall-focused — emphasizes exhaustive extraction of borderline entities
